rows.text: Building collapsed near Paltan Bazaar, 6 people trapped under debris. Need first aid kits urgently.

Boat capsized near Ganeshguri, 8 people in the water, urgent!
SOS! Khanapara overbridge area completely under water, 20 passengers stuck inside a bus, water level rising.

Six Mile flyover side: a house caved in, 3 children trapped inside. Help immediately.
